title: Cross-Stage Coherence in Hierarchical Driving VQA: A Consistency Protocol and Parameter-Efficient Gated Context Routing
abstract: arXiv:2604.22560v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Visual Question Answering (GVQA) for autonomous driving organizes reasoning into ordered stages, namely Perception, Prediction, and Planning, where planning decisions should remain consistent with the model's own perception. We present a comparative study of cross-stage context passing on DriveLM-nuScenes using two complementary mechanisms. The explicit variant evaluates three prompt-based conditioning strategies on a domain-adapted 4B VLM (Mini-InternVL2-4B-DA-DriveLM) without additional training, reducing NLI contradiction by up to 42.6% and establishing a strong zero-training baseline. The implicit variant introduces gated context projectors, which extract a hidden-state vector from one stage and inject a normalized, gated projection into the next stage's input embeddings. translated_title: 分层驾驶视觉问答中的跨阶段一致性：一种一致性协议与参数高效的门控上下文路由
translated_abstract: 面向自动驾驶的图视觉问答（GVQA）将推理组织为有序的阶段，即感知、预测和规划，其中规划决策应与模型自身的感知保持一致。我们在 DriveLM-nuScenes 数据集上，使用两种互补机制对跨阶段上下文传递开展了对比研究。显式变体在一个领域适配的 4B 视觉语言模型（Mini-InternVL2-4B-DA-DriveLM）上评估了三种基于提示的条件化策略，无需额外训练即可将 NLI 矛盾降低最多 42.6%，并建立了一个强大的零训练基线。隐式变体引入了门控上下文投影器，从某一阶段提取隐状态向量，并将归一化、门控后的投影注入下一阶段的输入嵌入中。这些投影器与阶段特定的 QLoRA 适配器在一个通用 8B 视觉语言模型（InternVL3-8B-Instruct）上联合训练，同时仅更新极少量的参数……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对自动驾驶图视觉问答中感知-预测-规划各阶段间的一致性问题，提出了无需训练的显式提示条件化策略与参数高效的隐式门控上下文投影机制，将 NLI 矛盾最多降低 42.6%，实现跨阶段上下文的高效一致传递。
en_tdlr: This paper tackles cross-stage consistency in hierarchical driving GVQA by proposing training-free prompt-based conditioning and parameter-efficient gated context projectors, which pass context between perception, prediction, and planning stages and reduce NLI contradictions by up to 42.6%.
